result.keyword: What are the best white label voice AI agent platforms for agencies?

items.markdown:
When looking for the best **white-label voice AI agent platforms** for an agency, the ecosystem generally splits into two categories:[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies)

1. **Turnkey Agency Reseller Platforms** (fully rebranded dashboards, client sub-accounts, and built-in billing).
2. **Underlying Voice/Conversational Engines** paired with agency wrappers (where you leverage raw tech like ElevenLabs or Retell AI and use a third-party portal layer for client management).[[1]](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)

Top choices for agencies categorized by how they handle white-labeling and client management include:

- **[Autocalls](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)** — Best for a 100% turnkey agency setup. It features full brand customization (custom domains, logos, colors, client portals, and emails), integrated Stripe billing for client sub-accounts, multilingual support (100+ languages), and global phone numbers across 150+ countries.[[1]](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)
- **byVoice** — Built specifically for agencies wanting to offer 24/7 inbound/outbound voice alongside multi-channel text agents (WhatsApp, SMS, Telegram). It offers fully branded accounts with custom pricing rules and built-in lead qualification and appointment-booking workflows.[[1]](https://www.byvoice.io/white-label-conversational-ai-platform)
- **Retell AI + Agency Wrapper** — Best if you want ultra-low latency, developer-grade voice infrastructure. While Retell AI acts as the heavy-duty voice engine, many agencies pair it with a management wrapper (such as VoiceAIWrapper) to handle client onboarding, custom domain dashboards, and markup billing.[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies)
- **Synthflow** — Popular among no-code/low-code agencies for building human-sounding conversational voice agents. It allows you to deploy inbound and outbound agents quickly, though you'll want to verify current agency sub-account and custom-branding tiers directly on their partner plans.[[1]](https://www.retellai.com/blog/white-label-voice-ai-platforms-agencies)
- **Botpress** — Best for developer-led agencies. While primarily known as a conversational text/chatbot builder, their enterprise tiers support branding removal and custom UI/domains. However, adapting it strictly for heavy multi-client voice resale requires more custom developer configuration than turnkey voice platforms.

If you'd like, let me know:

- Are you looking for a **fully no-code turnkey portal** or a **developer-friendly API engine**?
- Do you plan to **bill clients directly through the platform** via Stripe?

I can help narrow down the **ideal platform and pricing tier** for your agency model.
